text: サチとの　コンビが　やぶられる　とは…

structure.jp: サチとの　コンビが

structure.en: to think it would be beaten...

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは at the end of a statement shows shock at it, with the rest left unsaid. やぶられる　とは = 'to think it would be beaten...'

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending turns 'to beat' into 'to be beaten', so the thing it happens to comes first. やぶられる = 'gets beaten'.

patterns.name: 〜との
patterns.explanation: と 'with' plus の lets a 'with someone' phrase describe a thing. サチとの　コンビ = 'the team-up with Kia'.
